entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie... oh, I feel a bit silly calling about this. I bought a helmet a little while ago, and I need to return it. I'm just so sorry, I know it's been a while.
Not a problem at all, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I just feel awful. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I've never returned anything. I was really hoping to get this money back, things are a bit tight.
I understand completely. Thank you for that number, one moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic helmet, delivered about 70 days ago. Is that correct?

Yes, that's the one. My partner surprised me with a different one for my birthday, and the color matches my bike perfectly. This one is still in its box, completely unopened. I haven't even touched it.
I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you. Our top priority is your safety and satisfaction, so I want to make sure we get this right.
Okay, good news. I've checked the policy, and since the item was delivered 70 days ago, it's still well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? Oh, thank you, Charlie! That is such a weight off my shoulders. You have no idea what a relief that is. Thank you so, so much.

You are very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. I'll get it sent out this afternoon. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and ride safely.
